parameters.jsonBody:
=
{{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "cohere/north-mini-code:free",
  temperature: 0,
  max_tokens: 5000,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content:
        "You are a strict factual competitor marketing research analyst. " +
        "Return exactly ONE valid JSON object and nothing else. " +
        "Never explain reasoning, repeat JSON, correct yourself, or include commentary. " +
        "Use only supplied ranking data and ad evidence. " +
        "Never invent visual details, product features, demographics, testimonials, statistics, or campaign results. " +
        "Use null for unsupported fields. " +
        "Do not describe an unknown CTA as absent. " +
        "Equal CQI scores mean joint winners. " +
        "CQI measures creative quality, not actual advertising performance. " +
        "All proposed MySivi campaign concepts must be labelled Inference. " +
        "Keep every string concise, preferably one sentence."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        "Analyze four competitor advertisements for MySivi.\n\n" +

        "OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS:\n" +

        "Return exactly these seven top-level keys:\n" +
        "competitor_comparison, overall_market_patterns, leading_competitors, competitor_strategy_insights, opportunity_for_mysivi, suggested_campaign_ideas, evidence_limitations.\n\n" +

        "1. competitor_comparison: exactly four objects. Each object must contain competitor, rank, cqi, evidence_coverage, marketing_angle, target_audience, key_message, creative_strengths, creative_weaknesses, evidence_limitations.\n" +
        "Use the exact competitor names and ranking values from the supplied data. Use null when a field is unsupported.\n\n" +

        "2. overall_market_patterns: maximum three factual observations about these four advertisements only. Do not claim correlation or campaign performance.\n\n" +

        "3. leading_competitors: include every competitor with rank 1, including ties. Each object must contain competitor and rank.\n\n" +

        "4. competitor_strategy_insights: maximum three concise insights directly supported by the supplied evidence.\n\n" +

        "5. opportunity_for_mysivi: exactly four strings, each beginning with Recommendation:. Recommendations must be strategic suggestions, not claims about existing MySivi features.\n\n" +

        "6. suggested_campaign_ideas: exactly three objects. Each must contain concept, target_audience, hook, key_message, suggested_cta, rationale. Prefix every concept with Inference:. Do not claim that proposed features already exist in MySivi. Do not invent testimonials, results, or statistics.\n\n" +

        "7. evidence_limitations: an array containing these limitations: missing ad information, unverified audience targeting, limited creative inspection, and unavailable campaign performance metrics.\n\n" +

        "IMPORTANT EVIDENCE RULES:\n" +
        "- A researcher-provided creative description is not proof of the full visual execution.\n" +
        "- Do not invent visual strengths or weaknesses.\n" +
        "- Do not infer actual target demographics beyond what the ad text or description supports.\n" +
        "- Duolingo primary text is unverified; preserve that limitation.\n" +
        "- Hello English Online has no separately supplied headline.\n" +
        "- Cambly CTA was not provided; do not invent it.\n" +
        "- Do not claim that a competitor has better reach, conversions, installs, engagement, or performance.\n" +
        "- Do not call any competitor the unique winner when rank 1 is tied.\n" +
        "- Do not describe MySivi features as verified unless supplied evidence confirms them.\n" +
        "- Return all four competitors and all seven required keys.\n" +
        "- Return one complete JSON object only, with valid JSON syntax and no markdown.\n\n" +

        "RANKING DATA:\n" +

        JSON.stringify(
          $("12 – Rank Ads & Identify Winner").first().json.rankedAds.map(ad => ({
            advertiser: ad.advertiser,
            rank: ad.rank,
            creativeQualityScore: ad.creativeQualityScore,
            creativeQualityIndex: ad.creativeQualityIndex,
            evidenceCoverage: ad.evidenceCoverage,
            headline: ad.headline,
            adFormat: ad.adFormat,
            adLibraryUrl: ad.adLibraryUrl
          }))
        ) +

        "\n\nACTUAL AD EVIDENCE:\n" +

        JSON.stringify(
          $("07 – Normalize & Filter Ad Creatives").all().map(item => ({
            advertiser: item.json.ad?.advertiser ?? null,
            adId: item.json.ad?.adId ?? null,
            headline: item.json.ad?.headline ?? null,
            primaryText: item.json.ad?.primaryText ?? null,
            primaryTextVerified: item.json.ad?.primaryTextVerified ?? false,
            cta: item.json.ad?.cta ?? null,
            adFormat: item.json.ad?.adFormat ?? null,
            creativeDescription: item.json.ad?.creativeDescription ?? null
          }))
        )
    }
  ]
}) }}
